method.score: activity × clear sky × darkness × moon & lights
method.clear_definition: at least 2 consecutive dark hours with cloud cover ≤ 40%

weekly.geomagnetic: Geomagnetic field activity is likely to reach G1 (Minor) geomagnetic storm levels on 22 Oct. Active conditions are likely over 04-06 Oct, 21 Oct, and 23-24 Oct. Unsettled conditions are likely over 07-08 Oct and 11-14 Oct. All increases in geomagnetic activity are associated with anticipated influence from multiple, recurrent, coronal hole HSSs. The remainder of the outlook period is likely to be at mostly quiet levels.

three_day.rationale: G1 (Minor) storm levels are likely on 04 Oct due to the influence of a coronal hole high-speed stream.
three_day.summary: The greatest expected 3 hr Kp for Oct 03-Oct 05 2026 is 4.67 (NOAA Scale G1)
